review_candidates.description_excerpt: Qualifications University degree, (minimum bachelor’s degree) or equivalent professional qualification, preferably in engineering, computer science, telecommunications, electrical engineering, data centre engineering, semiconductor engineering, physics, applied sciences or a related discipline. By applying for this position, you acknowledge the importance of maintaining the security and integrity of the Information of the EIB Group.
eligibility_evidence: The EIB offers you the opportunity to live and work in a truly international and multi-cultural environment.

You will monitor developments across technology, markets and public policy, translate them into practical insights for internal stakeholders, and help develop external cooperation with the European Commission, international financial institutions, specialised institutes and industry partners.

You will build strong working relationships with project promoters, private-sector leaders, public authorities, EU institutions, international bodies, specialised institutes and other financial institutions, and represent the EIB at selected sector events and high-level project meetings.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Qualifications University degree, (minimum bachelor’s degree) or equivalent professional qualification, preferably in engineering, computer science, telecommunications, electrical engineering, data centre engineering, semiconductor engineering, physics, applied sciences or a related discipline. As both English and French are however official working languages of the EIB, proficiency in both languages is a pre-requisite for your future career development. Proficiency is understood to mean the attainment of level 5 of the Inter Institutional language courses, corresponding to B1.2 of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFRL).
